items.text: Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson as a full participant in Wednesday’s practice, the first time since his ankle injury. He has missed the past three games after limited work last week.
items.why: First full practice since Week 4 ankle injury; trending toward return vs Bills.
items.implication: Major unlock for Ravens offense and fantasy upside if cleared to play.
items.opportunity: Increased passing volume and efficiency for skill players; dual-threat QB production returns.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) were listed as non-participants at Wednesday’s practice.
items.why: Shoulder for Gibbs, ankle for St. Brown; no immediate indication of missing Sunday vs Vikings but monitor Thursday/Friday.
items.implication: Potential limited or game-time if no progress; high-end usage otherwise intact.
items.opportunity: If either sits or limited, increased role for Jameson Williams and other Lions backs/receivers.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle suffered an aggravation of his previous chest injury on the reverse last week; status for Sunday vs Chiefs TBD based on practice. Did not practice Wednesday.
items.why: Aggravation of preexisting chest injury; availability hinges on remaining practices.
items.opportunity: Courtland Sutton and other Broncos WRs see expanded targets if Waddle sits or limited.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love returns to practice (Cardinals injury report).
items.why: Rookie RB easing back after missing recent games with ankle; first practice return noted.
items.implication: Trending toward availability or increased role soon; monitor designation.
items.opportunity: Potential carries/snaps in ARI backfield if cleared; reverse any prior backup beneficiaries.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup?
items.why: Designated return from IR/chest; evaluating immediate start viability post-absence.
items.implication: Monitor role/snaps in SEA backfield; potential flex if volume materializes.
items.opportunity: Carries and possible pass-game work upon full clearance.

items.text: Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as a non-participant in Wednesday’s practice due to an ankle injury and rest.
items.why: NIR-rest/ankle; believed maintenance-related rather than new significant issue.
items.implication: Expected to return to practice and play Week 8 vs Titans if progresses.
items.opportunity: Tee Higgins and other Bengals pass-catchers temporary bump if limited, but Chase remains WR1 when active.

items.text: Truly special stuff from Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Loses Klint Kubiak, limited dynamic threats, DCs shading coverage, stadium knows where ball is going—yet ripping off 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies.
items.why: Massive overperformance relative to opportunity despite schematic and coverage challenges post-Kubiak.
items.implication: Sustainable WR1 production even in tougher environment; trust the talent and volume.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets continue; elite efficiency unlocks ceiling.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited in Wednesday practice (first participation since Week 4 injury); availability vs Broncos uncertain. Mahomes full, Kelce full.
items.why: First practice work after missing three games; GTD potential.
items.implication: Monitor for return; if out, Worthy and others elevated.
items.opportunity: Targets reopen if active; reverse stale beneficiaries if IN.

items.text: Ravens 6th in yards per play despite Huntley 50.1% snaps. Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley. Very excited to see Declan Doyle cook with healthy Lamar Jackson.
items.why: Elite efficiency already without Lamar; full participation unlocks higher volume and scoring.
items.implication: Flowers becomes must-start WR1 with Lamar return; offense overall spikes.
items.opportunity: YPRR leader + QB upgrade = massive target/route and TD upside.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Give me Olave. I’d rather sell the unproven rookie.
items.why: Prefer selling established but perhaps peaking/volatile Olave over unproven rookie Tyson in trade scenarios.
items.implication: Olave still startable but trade value may be higher now; reassess ROS.
items.opportunity: Targets remain but situation/QB volatility noted.

items.text: I’m KEEPING IT OPEN on Sam LaPorta. He could be in for a big day against a Vikings defense that’s sure to put pressure on Jared Goff.
items.why: Matchup vs Vikings pressure likely creates TE opportunities; Lions TE production strong.
items.implication: Start with confidence; upside TE1 week.
items.opportunity: Routes and red-zone looks in high-scoring Lions offense.

items.text: “I do think it’s time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman” — Evan Silva and Adam Levitan discuss DEN’s backfield and Coleman’s return.
items.why: ETR analysts advocate shifting to Coleman in Broncos backfield post-return amid committee.
items.implication: Waiver priority or stash as DEN RB opportunity expands; handcuff/committee play.
items.opportunity: Potential snap/carry share growth in Sean Payton offense.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (calf) limited participant Wednesday; other notes include Demercado claimed by Texans and Pierce to IR (Eagles).
items.implication: Track progress for full role; TE1 when healthy.
items.opportunity: Routes and red-zone if cleared; Mayer or others if sits.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2 (behind only Allen), Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4 (behind JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given talent/schedule/concentration.
items.why: Dominant per-game production across skill positions driven by scheme, talent, and defensive woes of opponents.
items.implication: Continue prioritizing Lions stack pieces even with Wednesday DNPs; high floors/ceilings.
